question: After keeping operator space separate from content space, can a hard-selected development-photo AO6 context materially outperform both one global medoid and an oracle scalar-strength path on held camera groups?

protocol.global_baseline: development case medoid minimizing mean pairwise operator-signature RGB RMSE
protocol.strength_control: post-hoc least-squares scalar in [0,1.5] along the global-medoid residual direction
protocol.case_oracle: post-hoc hard Top-1 development case minimizing target RGB RMSE

branches.pass: freeze the case bank and open a separate content-space hard retrieval comparison; do not train a dense router
branches.strength_control_fail: treat apparent case diversity as a continuous strength path, retain K=1/global AO6 and do not create multiple cases
branches.oracle_value_fail: close case routing for this operator family and retain contextual AO6/global fallback
branches.self_replay_or_artifact_fail: invalidate the evaluator or case policy without threshold relaxation
branches.future_retrieval_fail: retain the descriptive Oracle result but keep the product path on the global/contextual champion

claim_ceiling: group-held evaluator-Oracle evidence for hard case reuse within one deterministic AO6 Look Approximation control; not content routing, film, stock, latent mode, calibration, authenticity, population preference or product promotion
